description: This file defines data transfer object (DTO) classes related to authentication in a Spring Boot backend. It includes records for login requests and token responses, with schema annotations for API documentation and validation constraints.

classes.name: AuthDtos.LoginRequest
classes.description: A data record for capturing login request details, including username and password with validation annotations.

classes.name: AuthDtos.TokenResponse
classes.description: A data record representing the response containing JWT access token, token type, and roles.
